q1_issues.issue: The hypothetical antecedent "A no-go from Schwarzenegger" is asserted as fact at (STV 1.0 0.99), claiming such a no-go exists when the sentence only supposes one (statement 1 asserts its source likewise).
Conditional "would clear" becomes (Future sk_clear_1) over event atoms asserted at full strength, turning a hypothesized consequence into a flat prediction that the track will be cleared.
"Los Angeles mayor" is rendered as (Possession richard_riordan los_angeles) on the person rather than on the office, asserting a Riordan/Los-Angeles relation the text states only of the mayoralty.

q2_gaps: a hypothetical "would V" whose antecedent is a nominal rather than an if-clause — neither Counterfactual (subjunctive had / would-have) nor the indicative-conditional Implication covers it, and there is no licensed way to withhold assertion from the consequent or from the nominal antecedent
"former N" as a prenominal cessation marker — the cessation rule is stated only for the "no longer / not anymore / used to" wordings
"another N" — the alterity presupposition (that Schwarzenegger is also a Republican) has no carrier
notes: Entity-attached From for "a no-go from Schwarzenegger", Beneficiary for the "for"-phrase, and the Past-plus-strength-0 pair used to render "former" all follow the instruction set. clear_the_track is taken as a fixed idiom, which the coherence test supports for these participants.
